credit_line: Gift of The Burnett Foundation and The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Vertical oil painting with two distinct bluish lines that run down the center of the canvas.  Peeping out of these lines are two small half spheres in pink, as if emerging from behind curtains, located in the upper center of the painting.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Georgia O'Keeffe Museum. Photo: Tim Nighswander/IMAGING4ART
